subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Wee hours of the day
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. “**Dawn**.”

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let’s look at the **meaning** of the given idiom/ phrase: 
 
• **The phrase** **‘****Wee hours of the day****’** means the early hours of a day, or the period immediately after midnight and before sunrise.
 
• ***Example***:
 
 
• *​Shloka wakes up in the **wee hour of the day** and starts his preparation for UPSC.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option ‘Dawn’, which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase.

 

Correct meaning:__ *Dawn.*
